description: The field-type palette. One designer slot renders one variant: docked, rail or compact.

parameters.name: Variant
parameters.description: Where the palette is rendered. One instance occupies one slot.

parameters.name: FieldTypes
parameters.description: Field types offered by the palette.

parameters.name: ShowMobileDraw
parameters.description: Whether the mobile draw button renders. Only the docked slot uses it.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Visible label of one field type.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: Icon name of one field type.

parameters.name: OnPointerDown
parameters.description: A press started on a palette item.

parameters.name: OnPointerUp
parameters.description: A press ended on a palette item.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: A click on a palette item.

parameters.name: OnMobileDraw
parameters.description: The mobile draw button was activated.
